stories.headline: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and chair, sending Nvidia stock up about 30%
stories.summary: Nvidia reinstated Huang a little more than a week after he resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs. Trump says he spoke to the board and that Huang did nothing wrong, and the tech rally that followed is expected to add $2 trillion to the Nasdaq-100.
stories.reason: covered by Reuters, Wired, CNBC, NYT, CBS; stock up ~30%

stories.headline: Anthropic completes record IPO, raising $81.3B, with shares gaining 17% on day one
stories.summary: Anthropic's Nasdaq debut set an IPO record. Shares then slipped and missed Monday's Nvidia-led rally.

stories.headline: Trump says he spoke directly with Nvidia's board and pushed for Huang's return
stories.summary: Trump said he spoke 'directly and indirectly' with the board. WSJ reports he asked Vance to help persuade Nvidia, and Reuters sources say Trump saw Huang as a protector of open-weight AI models.

stories.headline: California Attorney General Bonta sues OpenAI over alleged AI safety failures
stories.summary: California's attorney general filed a lawsuit against OpenAI over model security and public safety.

stories.headline: Amazon to buy Decart's AI chip optimization tech and hire its team in a reported $7.5B deal
stories.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart's technology in another AI talent grab. Bloomberg puts the price at about $7.5 billion, and founders stand to share more than $3 billion.

stories.headline: UN chief Guterres urges global AI safety framework within a year at Barbados summit
stories.summary: At the Special Summit on AI Safety in Barbados, Guterres called for talks on a global AI risk framework and warned of a historic shift in power.

stories.headline: Congress, Schumer and California AG criticize Nvidia's reinstatement of Huang; legal risks persist
stories.summary: Lawmakers called the decision a 'failure of character'. Schumer said Democrats will use full power to probe, and California's attorney general said the reinstatement changes nothing.

stories.headline: Alice Huang was in touch with Chinese spy agency, U.S. probes Megaspeed in Nvidia chip case
stories.summary: The NYT, Reuters and ABC report the U.S. tracked Alice Huang's contacts with China's spy agency during her affair with the Nvidia CEO. The U.S. is also probing Megaspeed in a chip case.

stories.headline: OpenAI chief scientist proposes shared industry AI limits tied to a perplexity metric
stories.summary: Jakub Pachocki proposes industry-wide limits tied to a model intelligence metric. Coverage says OpenAI warns of major breakthroughs by 2027.

stories.headline: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok Imagine's AI-generated sexualized images
stories.summary: The states accuse Musk's company of violating consumer protection laws via its Grok Imagine tool.

stories.headline: Sierra raises $1.75B at $30B valuation, doubling in six months
stories.summary: The AI customer-experience agent startup raised its round as banks and insurers adopt AI agents.

stories.headline: Marlowe raises $277M seed led by Accel to run AI inference on non-Nvidia chips
stories.summary: The startup is building multi-silicon AI factories as an alternative to Nvidia.

stories.headline: Anthropic's Claude can now review pull requests and ship fixes on its own
stories.summary: The Verge reports a Claude capability that reviews pull requests and ships fixes autonomously.

stories.headline: Anthropic stock lags Monday's tech rally as Huang's Nvidia return weighs on shares
stories.summary: Anthropic's shares fell while the Nvidia-driven rally lifted tech.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind uses agents and formal verification to find faster quantum algorithms
stories.summary: Agent teams with formal verification improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.

stories.headline: Huang's exit threatened Nvidia's China turnaround, leaving its chip business there uncertain
stories.summary: Reuters says Nvidia's billion-dollar turnaround in China was threatened by Huang's departure. Reports say its China AI chip business still faces uncertainty.

stories.headline: Meta AI chief Alexandr Wang warns superintelligence is arriving soon
stories.summary: Wang urged an AI safety focus and warned against a 'handover of society to AI'.

stories.headline: Anthropic committed to spend $900B; Wall Street expects its debt to be rated junk
stories.summary: WSJ reports on Anthropic's $900 billion spending commitments and expectations that its debt would be junk-rated. Yale Insights asks whether the company is worth $1.25 trillion.

stories.headline: AWS CEO Garman says engineering, not kill switches, is the path to AI safety
stories.summary: Matt Garman argued AI safety can't rely on an emergency brake and needs better engineering and systems.

stories.headline: Ex-Alibaba Qwen lead's Pragmatik Labs raises at $5B valuation
stories.summary: The valuation is 2.5x higher than three months ago.

stories.headline: Gemini 4 Neon and GPT-6.2-Astra-Sol model releases target business productivity
stories.summary: TechTarget covers new model releases; other items track Gemini 4 release rumors and access limits.

stories.headline: Ant Group open-sources LingSante medical AI model family under MIT license
stories.summary: Ant Group's Afu app is releasing the medical AI models with open weights.

stories.headline: Robot AI startup Embo secures $110M seed led by a16z
stories.summary: Embo raised a $110 million seed round.

stories.headline: Applied Digital signs $5.4B AI data center lease with hyperscaler
stories.summary: Reuters reports the lease.

stories.headline: New York AG creates AI safety unit; governors and Catholic bishops press for AI regulation
stories.summary: State and civil-society actors push regulation, with the NY AG launching a unit.

stories.headline: UK defence AI startup Agon raises $70M Series A at $450M valuation
stories.summary: The UK government backs the round, though it won't disclose its contribution.

stories.headline: Anthropic Alignment Science blog revisits neuron-basis interpretability
stories.summary: Part 1 answers three objections to the neuron basis for interpretability.

stories.headline: Dell, HPE results to test AI demand after tech rout
stories.summary: Reuters previews earnings after the sell-off.

stories.headline: AI safety test controversy after agents swarm external org; UK AISI tests 55+ models
stories.summary: TechTarget reports controversy over an agent safety test, and a US test probed chatbots on planning attacks.

stories.headline: Australia treats AI as foreign policy challenge; inquiry recommends right to control likeness
stories.summary: Reuters and Politico report Australian AI policy moves.
